en.title: The k-th Missing Positive Integer
en.description:
Find the k-th smallest positive integer that does not appear in the array; duplicates do not take up extra positions.

The standard input/output format and examples were compiled by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n k, and the second line contains the array. 1≤n≤200000, 1≤element≤10^9, 1≤k≤10^12.
hints: Deduplicate and sort the array, then starting from 1 compute the gaps between consecutive present values segment by segment to locate the gap containing k, or the range after the maximum value.
